payload.reason: Record the agreed SMS provider change from the 2026-10-13 weekly sync.
payload.name: Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch
payload.body:
# SMS reminder provider: Sinch

Decided on 2026-10-13 by Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, and Kenji Watanabe.

## Decision
SMS reminders move to **Sinch** from 2026-11-01; Vonage is no longer the provider.

## Why
Vonage continues to fail on Portuguese numbers.

## Context
The public launch occurred on 2026-10-06 as planned, and early clinic feedback is good.

payload.reason: Record the agreed product analytics vendor change from the 2026-10-14 message.
payload.name: Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud in the EU region
payload.body:
# Product analytics vendor: PostHog Cloud in the EU region

Decided on 2026-10-14 by Maya Okafor and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Product analytics switches to **PostHog Cloud in the EU region**.

## Why
Self-hosting PostHog is taking too much operations time while clinic data must remain in the EU.

payload.reason: Record the agreed release cadence change from the 2026-10-15 message.
payload.name: Decision - Releases ship Tuesdays and Thursdays behind feature flags
payload.body:
# Release cadence: Tuesdays and Thursdays behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-15 by Daniel Reyes and Tom Lindqvist.

## Decision
Ship releases **twice weekly on Tuesdays and Thursdays**, still behind feature flags.

## Why
Continuous deploys are surprising pilot clinics in the middle of the day.

# Investor update cadence: monthly with the metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-10-16 by Maya Okafor.

## Decision
Investor updates return to a **monthly** cadence, while retaining the metrics dashboard link.

## Why
Brightpath asked Fernwork to slow down.
